_comment: Procedural table for Locations. faction is picked from the world's own live faction roster (or 'unaligned'). notableNpcs[] is left empty by default (a procedural Location shouldn't invent a fake NPC id that doesn't exist in the roster) -- lib/proceduralGenerators.js may link an existing NPC if this world already has one archived, same 'reference, don't invent' principle roster.js follows elsewhere.

descriptorLineTemplates.value: Nobody planned for it to end up like this. Nobody's fixed it either.
Whatever this place used to be, it's had a long time to become something else.
Quiet in a way that puts people on edge, and probably should.
Still standing, mostly out of spite.
The kind of place people pass through fast, or not at all.

notableFeaturesTemplates.value: A tangle of {regionBiome} that's been picked over more than once, but never quite cleaned out. Whatever's left is worth the risk to whoever gets there first.

The layout here rewards knowing it -- shortcuts, blind spots, and at least one route that isn't on any map still in circulation. Getting turned around in {regionBiome} like this can cost more than time.
Signs of recent activity are everywhere -- fresh tracks, disturbed debris, a fire pit still warm. Something is using this stretch of {regionBiome}, regularly.
Half-collapsed and half-improvised into something livable, this corner of {regionBiome} has clearly been claimed by someone, even if they're not obviously present right now.
Old signage and structural bones hint at what this {regionBiome} used to serve, before whatever happened here happened.

hooksSecretsTemplates.value: Something valuable is rumored to still be buried here -- enough people have gone looking, and not come back, that most locals treat the rumor as fact.
A sealed section hasn't been opened in longer than anyone currently around can explain, and whoever sealed it left it that way for a reason.
This place quietly changes hands more often than anyone advertises -- worth knowing who actually controls it before showing up uninvited.
No secrets surfaced yet -- a straightforward roster addition, ready for a hook to be added later.
Locals avoid one specific part of it, for reasons nobody's willing to fully explain to an outsider.

designNotes.value: Rolled procedurally -- region/danger tags are solid, but notableFeatures/hooksSecrets are Mad-Libs placeholders worth a manual pass before this location anchors a real scene.
